title: Sleepy lion cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='#d98b2b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='8' fill='#d98b2b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='8' fill='#d98b2b'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='4' fill='#f2b368'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='4' fill='#f2b368'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='22' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#fbe3bf'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M34 50 q6 5 12 0' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 50 q6 5 12 0' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 60 h8 l-4 4 z' fill='#c0603f'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 64 q0 4 -4 4' stroke='#b07a4a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 64 q0 4 4 4' stroke='#b07a4a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='60' r='4' fill='#f4a6a6'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='60' r='4' fill='#f4a6a6'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M72 28 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#9ecbff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M80 16 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#9ecbff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
